title: Orca mod bundle: mod.json
description: What Orca's engine reads from a mod bundle (YouGame docs/ORCA_MODS.md, section 2.1 and the Phase 1 contract). Orca's parser (Source/Core/Core/Orca/Mod.cpp, ParseManifest) is the reference; this schema states the same rules for the site's publish check, and the unit test OrcaMod.SchemaMatchesTheEngine keeps the lists here equal to the engine's. Anything unknown or malformed refuses the session. Rules a JSON schema can't state are in x-orca-rules.

api.description: The script API version the mod needs; Orca refuses a mod above its own (Mod::ENGINE_API).

minOrca.description: The oldest Orca release the mod runs on. The app and site compare it with the installed Orca's version; the engine checks only its form.

title.description: The window title's name for the game. Empty: the disc's own.

launcher.description: A loader program at the bundle's root that boots the disc from the drive (Project+'s Netplay Launcher). Must be in the tree.

sd.description: The SD card: built from exactly the tree's sd/ files into an SDSC image of this size.

frameHook.description: The game's frame boundary: an instruction address in MEM1 and the word expected there.

firstKeyframeFrame.description: No drop-in keyframe of the boot's frames before this one, and no friend plugs in before it. Default 300.

keepGameCode.description: [address, the game's word, the mod's word]: an instruction fetch at the address gets the game's word while memory holds the mod's (ORCA.md, "Code the JIT doesn't see").

saveTitle.description: The title whose save seeds the session NAND: only the disc's own (0x00010000 and the 4-character game code).

forced.description: Settings the mod pins, from the engine's allowlist only (Mod::ForcedAllowlist). Never dual core, FMA, the RTC switch, SD writes or folder sync, SKIP_EFB_COPY_TO_RAM, cheats or graphics mods. The SD card itself follows "sd".

builtin.description: Phase 1: the compiled UX modules the mod runs, each on only while its guard words hold. Only on RSBE01 revision 2.

offers.description: The caps the mod's logic provides; only with a builtin.

mem1Word.description: A word address in MEM1 (0x80000000-0x817FFFFC, a multiple of 4).

path.description: A bundle path: printable ASCII without <>:"\|?*, '/' between components, none empty, '.', '..', starting with a dot, ending in a dot or a space, or a Windows device name; at most 100 bytes.

tree.description: tree.json, written by the app: every file of the version except tree.json itself, sorted by path (byte order). tree = lowercase hex sha256 of "<path>\t<sha256>\t<bytes>\n" for every file but orca/jitwarm and orca/test/... (Tools/orca/mods/tree-hash-vector.json).

x-orca-rules: saveTitle equals the disc's own title ID: 0x00010000 followed by the hex of disc.id's first 4 characters (RSBE01: 0x0001000052534245).
builtin is only for disc RSBE01 revision 2.
offers is empty unless builtin is set.
keepGameCode: no address twice; the game's word differs from the mod's.
launcher, when set, names a file in the tree.
Every orca/patches/<name>.patches file parses (Source/Core/Core/Orca/UX/GamePatches.h); they apply in path order.

tree.json: paths sorted by bytes and unique, also ignoring ASCII case; no path is both a file and a folder (ignoring case); tree.json is not listed; tree equals the hash of the list; every file exists at its listed size.
Paths are ASCII only, so the Unicode-normalisation collision rule of docs/ORCA_MODS.md 2.3 can't arise.
